propositions: Code snapshot entries exhibit 4x write amplification across adjacent-SHA resolutions due to redundant full blob writes without hardlinking or delta compression against neighbouring entries.
The materialize() populate branch builds code trees via _materialize_tree (git read-tree + git checkout-index) with no blob reuse, mirroring the pre-8386 tickets bug pattern.
Bug 8386 introduced delta_tree.py as a generic donor-selection and hardlink-clone helper but deliberately scoped it out of code entries due to attestation concerns.

Code snapshots serve as the attestation basis for signed verdicts, so storage sharing changes must preserve byte-for-byte faithfulness to committed trees and maintain correct LFS-pointer and submodule caveat computation.
